before.name: University "Alcalá de Henares" in Madrid, Spain is built

changes.name: Cardinal Cisneros founds a university in Alcalá de Henares with papal authorization

updates.review_note: The 15th-century source loosely says the university was built in 1499. Complutense University describes papal authorization to found the college in 1499 and construction completion in 1508; university sources and Spain’s Ministry of Culture identify the university foundation as 1499. Wording no longer asserts the buildings were completed in 1499. A Studium Generale existed in Alcalá from 1293, and the historic institution moved to Madrid in the 19th century. The point is the modern municipality of Alcalá de Henares, a reference for the institution, not the precise site of issuance of the bull or a building footprint. The 20 km radius is gameplay only. The old point is in northeastern Spain, far from Alcalá. A targeted scan of all indexed 1499 names found no duplicate university event, but differently worded duplicates cannot be ruled out. Other historical college foundation-stone dates are presented inconsistently, so no day is asserted.
